# Drake Stapleton
> AI Architect & Operator · Freedom Fighter. A personal record of projects, research, and the journey behind the work. Open to good conversation and research collaborations that advance accountable AI on dedicated silicon.

Drake Stapleton documents sovereign systems architecture, native inference runtimes, hardware TPM key vault protection, industrial manufacturing engineering, and the Atlas continuity program.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.drakestapleton.com/): overview, proof strip, and systems summary
- [Projects](https://www.drakestapleton.com/projects): the sovereign systems family (Atlas, AEGIS, AIEN)
- [Research](https://www.drakestapleton.com/research): LLM inference research paper and telemetry on Grace Blackwell
- [Life](https://www.drakestapleton.com/life): personal journey, family history, foster care service, and foundational values
- [Evidence Hub](https://www.drakestapleton.com/evidence): canonical claims database, verification levels, and reproduction commands
- [Career Path](https://www.drakestapleton.com/path): chemist to manufacturing engineer to AI Architect
- [Software](https://www.drakestapleton.com/software): systems architecture and software engineering record
- [Atlas](https://www.drakestapleton.com/atlas): personal accountable AI research and continuous record
- [AEGIS](https://www.drakestapleton.com/aegis): defensive perimeter containment and evidence preservation
- [AIEN](https://www.drakestapleton.com/aien): sovereign cognitive architecture on dedicated silicon
- [Symphony](https://www.drakestapleton.com/symphony): multi-model orchestration process
